title: Texture Image Map (TIM2 .tm2) with the FFXII eXt icon table

container.notes: Little-endian TIM2: 0x10 file header, 0x30 picture header, optional "eXt\0" icon block (sections -> groups -> 8-byte icons, 16 CLUT-group bytes), pixel data, then 256-colour RGBA CLUTs (PS2 halved alpha). Also embedded in otherpack/EBP section 6/himgd containers.

records.name: fileHeader
records.where: File offset 0 (or start of the embedded TIM2 inside a container section).

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: ASCII "TIM2". [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:13, 35-38; IW Helpers/PackHelper.cs:21]

fields.name: formatRevision
fields.notes: File format revision (round-tripped). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:40, 276]

fields.name: format
fields.notes: Format byte (round-tripped). In generic TIM2 this selects 16- vs 128-byte alignment (general knowledge). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:41, 277]

fields.name: pictureCount
fields.notes: Number of pictures; the Workshop reads/writes exactly 1. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:42, 279]

fields.name: reserved08
fields.notes: Reserved, 8 bytes (skipped/zero). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:42, 280]

fields.name: totalSize
fields.notes: Picture size = headerSize + imageSize + clutSize. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:46, 285, 288]

fields.name: clutSize
fields.notes: CLUT bytes (1024 per 256-colour CLUT). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:46, 283, 289]

fields.name: imageSize
fields.notes: Pixel data bytes. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:47, 290]

fields.name: headerSize
fields.notes: Picture header size INCLUDING the eXt block (0x30 + eXt size). Pixel data starts at pictureHeader + headerSize. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:48, 66, 259, 291]

fields.name: clutColors
fields.notes: CLUT colour count; number of 256-colour CLUTs = (clutColors + 0xFF) >> 8 (FFXII menu textures carry several CLUTs = "layers"). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:49, 286, 292]

fields.name: pictureFormat
fields.notes: Picture format. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:53, 293]

fields.name: mipmapCount
fields.notes: Mipmap count (the Workshop writes 1). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:54, 295]

fields.name: clutColorType
fields.notes: CLUT colour type (low bits; generic TIM2 puts extra flags in the high bits). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:55; TK L1153]

fields.name: imageColorType
fields.notes: Image colour type. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:56; TK L1153]

fields.name: width
fields.notes: Image width in pixels. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:57]

fields.name: height
fields.notes: Image height in pixels. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:58]

fields.name: gsTex0
fields.notes: GS TEX0 register value (round-tripped by the Workshop). Bit layout per the PS2 GS; the Toolkit exposes PSM / CPSM / TFX with its own enums. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:59; PS2 GS TEX0 register layout (general PS2 knowledge, not from our sources); TK L1153]

fields.name: gsTex1
fields.notes: GS TEX1 register value (round-tripped). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:60]

fields.name: gsFlags
fields.notes: GS flags register (round-tripped). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:61]

fields.name: gsTexClut
fields.notes: GS TEXCLUT register (round-tripped). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:62]

records.name: extHeader
records.where: pictureHeader + 0x30 (= file 0x40) when the 4 bytes there are "eXt\0"; absent otherwise. All offsets below are relative to the start of this block.

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: "eXt" + NUL (65 58 74 00). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:88, 429]

fields.name: extSize
fields.notes: Size of the whole eXt block (= headerSize - 0x30, 16-aligned). Pixel data follows it. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:94, 108, 260, 309]

fields.name: extSizeCopy
fields.notes: Same value again. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:95, 310]

fields.name: reserved0C
fields.notes: Reserved (skipped). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:95, 311]

fields.name: iconEntryListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of the icon entry list (8-byte iconEntry records). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:96, 247, 313]

fields.name: clutListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of the 16-byte CLUT-group table. clutGroups byte count = iconEntryListOffset - clutListOffset (must be 16). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:97-105, 244, 314, 442]

records.name: iconSectionIndex
records.where: extHeader + 0x14 + 2*i, i = 0 .. sectionCount-1. The FIRST value equals sectionCount (the group lists start right after this list).

fields.name: firstGroupIndex
fields.notes: Index, in u16 units from extHeader+0x14, of this section's first group entry; groups of section i = [value(i), value(i+1)); the last section runs until the scan hits 0 or the CLUT table. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:100-135, 226-231]

fields.name: firstIconIndex
fields.notes: Index of the group's first icon in the icon entry list; icons of a group = [value(j), value(j+1)); the last group runs until an all-zero icon entry or the pixel data. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:137-165, 233-239]

fields.name: clutGroup
fields.notes: 16 CLUT-group bytes (exactly 16 entries are required). An icon's clutGroupLink (0-15) selects one of them. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:104-105, 245, 442]

records.name: iconEntry
records.count: sum of all groups' icon counts

fields.name: x
fields.notes: Left edge of the icon inside the texture (pixels). [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:165, 250]

fields.name: y
fields.notes: Top edge. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:166, 251]

fields.name: attributes
fields.notes: Packed size and CLUT links. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:167-172, 253]

fields.name: red
fields.notes: Red. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:76-80]

fields.name: green
fields.notes: Green.

fields.name: blue
fields.notes: Blue.

fields.name: alpha
fields.notes: Alpha in PS2 range (0x80 = opaque); the Workshop doubles it on export and halves it (rounding up) on import. [src: IW Formats/Tim2.cs:271, 337]

roundTrip: Keep formatRevision, format, pictureFormat, colour types and all four GS register values unchanged unless re-encoding the pixel data.
CLUT alpha stays in PS2 range (0x00-0x80); convert x2 only for display.
Keep exactly 16 clutGroups bytes and the zero padding to 16 after the index lists and after the icon list.
In-place edits of icon x/y/width/height and CLUT links are safe (no size change).
Copy the reserved bytes and the eXt reserved dword unchanged.
gaps: Meaning of the clutGroups bytes and of additiveClutEntryLink beyond their index ranges.
Multi-picture files (pictureCount > 1) and mipmaps: not handled by the Workshop; not seen documented for FFXII.
Exact semantics of pictureFormat / format bytes in FFXII files.
Runtime texture registry layout at [0x02090780] (only its count is located).
The "last section/group" length rule relies on scanning for zero values (Workshop heuristic); an editor should prefer explicit counts when rebuilding.
